purpose: Kannon Town v3 (checkpoint dressing, golden-hour bake) versus Kannon Town v2 at identical camera, canvas and quality settings.

protocol.desktop: 1280x720 CSS, DPR 1, High fixed, desktop presentation stack
protocol.phone: 852x393 CSS, DPR 1, hasTouch/isMobile, Auto fixed = phone tier with the phone GLBs

limits: Desktop browser touch emulation, not physical iPhone performance.
GPU timer values vary with driver scheduling and clocks; repeat brackets are retained, not averaged away.
Both towns are resident in the comparison page, so memory figures are not production memory.
Each side is lit with its own real-time light settings; lighting therefore differs between the two variants by design.
